four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: unclear -- the test did not cleanly let the claim express itself, but for MEASUREMENT reasons first and design reasons second (corrected 2026-09-04 after red-team F1). MECH-162's own notes name three permutations (z_resource alone, z_world alone, both fused); the run built the two single-seed arms and omitted an explicit fused arm. Because the retrieval-form fusion (module.py:2658) was live in BOTH arms, the contrast measured 'which stream seeds the goal cue' under an always-on identity->spatial retrieval, which is a legitimate but partial probe of re-convergence -- not two negative conditions as the draft first read it. Compounded by the readiness-failed seed inside the C1 denominator, equal weighting across 3-177 qualifying ticks, an untrained ResourceEncoder (P1 without P0), and a verdict that inverts under the manifest's own entry-weighted contrast. H0 (a fused input adds nothing over either stream alone) is therefore ALIVE, not eliminated on structure.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear, and it is an existence proof for the claim rather than against it. Kim et al. 2015 (dentate-gyrus disruption, delayed-non-match-to-place) gives causal lesion-style evidence that DG binds the internally-generated spatial map with externally-derived object/event information -- the targeted_review_q_030 entry says in terms that this 'supports MECH-162'. Staresina, Duncan & Davachi 2011 (PrC/PhC double dissociation with perceptual input equated) 'directly supports' SD-015 and MECH-162: separate encoders feeding a shared associative locus. Lee et al. 2021 (GIST, aggregate confidence 0.82) places the hippocampus as the convergence point 'consistent with MECH-162 and ARC-007'. The gap the literature itself names is the binding OPERATOR, not the convergence: Lee 2021's entry states 'the convergence locus is named but the binding mechanism (concatenation, multiplicative gating, cross-attention, factor-graph product) is not specified'.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: missing. (i) ree_core/latent/stack.py:288-291 documents ResourceEncoder's phased protocol -- 'P0: Train ResourceEncoder on benefit_exposure supervision (aux head). P1: Activate goal seeding from z_resource in update_z_goal()'. This run activated P1 with no P0 and no gradient training of any kind (grep of the driver for optim/backward/.train()/requires_grad/use_identity_classifier returns nothing), so z_resource is an untrained two-layer MLP on world_obs and z_world is a different untrained projection of the same observation. SD-015's own what_would_answer records the size of that gap: goal_resource_r 0.93-0.96 trained (V3-EXQ-514o under SD-057 on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding) 'up from the EXQ-085g baseline of 0.066-0.087' untrained. (ii) MECH-162's direct dependency SD-015 itself carries epistemic_category substrate_ceiling and pending_retest_after_substrate true. (iii) SD-015's stated non-degeneracy preconditions (a)-(d) are unmet here: no SD-057 incentive token bank, no scaffolded curriculum, no MECH-306 drive floor, and proximity_benefit_scale 0.05 against its stated >= 0.18.
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial for the mechanism the claim names -- CORRECTED after the red-team pass (Fable, 2026-09-04). The draft's absolute 'no operator anywhere fuses z_resource with z_world at the planning stage' was FALSE: HippocampalModule._propose_ghost_seeded (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:2576-2706) ranks MECH-292 bank anchors by goal_match against the z_resource-derived current_z_goal and then seeds each ghost probe's CEM init and E2 rollout at anchor.z_world (module.py:2658, :2676-2680). That is an identity-cue -> spatial-content RETRIEVAL operator at trajectory proposal, and it was LIVE in this run (use_mech293_ghost_probes on; mech293_n_ghost_admitted_nonzero_frac 0.50-0.965). What remains true: update_z_goal seeds z_goal from z_resource XOR z_world (agent.py ~11504) and GhostGoalBank.rank() itself never reads z_world, so there is no JOINT-REPRESENTATION operator (concatenation / gating / cross-attention over the two streams) -- the binding-operator gap the literature names (Lee 2021 entry) is real, but the claim's positive condition is NOT unobservable on this substrate: the retrieval form is one candidate instantiation of 're-converge at the planning stage', and the run's two arms differ in which stream SEEDS the cue that drives that retrieval, not in whether convergence is possible.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: partial. CausalGridWorldV2 at 20% resource density delivered abundant dual-type contact on 4 of 5 seeds (13-126 contacts per cell) but seed 43 obtained 1 and 0 contacts across a 3750-step budget in the two arms, and ARM_ZRESOURCE seed 46 sustained only 300 total steps (~12 steps/episode) against ARM_ZWORLD's 2952 on the same seed. With num_hazards=0 this early termination is not hazard death. The observation window is therefore not comparable across cells, which is the substrate of the confound recorded below. proximity_benefit_scale 0.05 also sits well under the >= 0.18 that SD-015's own retest preconditions name.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented, and decisively so. (1) The C1 denominator includes the readiness-failed seed: run_experiment computes C1 over all 5 seeds, not over the seeds that cleared R1/R2, and _run_cell returns a hardcoded 0.0 when discrim_samples is empty -- so seed 43 contributes d = 0.0-0.0 = 0.0 to the mean and, because the seed test is a strict `zr > zw`, `0.0 > 0.0` is False, making it structurally impossible for that seed to enter the numerator while it permanently occupies a denominator slot. Maximum attainable seed fraction is 0.8, and the 0.6 bar therefore demands 3 of the 4 informative seeds (75%), not 60%. (2) Per-seed estimates are equally weighted across qualifying-tick counts spanning 3 to 177 (59x); ARM_ZRESOURCE seed 46, one of the two seeds that decide the FAIL, rests on 3 ticks and clears ENGAGEMENT_FLOOR 0.10 at 0.200. (3) The verdict is not robust to aggregation: recomputing C1 from the entry-weighted contrast already recorded in the same manifest (mean_same_type_goal_match - mean_diff_type_goal_match) gives mean 0.10317 and seed fraction 0.60, i.e. C1 PASSES both halves. The per-tick and pooled forms disagree in SIGN on two ARM_ZWORLD cells (seed 42: pooled -0.00460 vs per-tick +0.07273; seed 47: pooled -0.01282 vs per-tick +0.02141). (4) Leave-one-out: dropping seed 47 alone takes the as-run mean to +0.00920, below the 0.02 floor. (5) Sign test on the 4 informative seeds is 2 positive / 2 negative, two-sided p = 1.000; t(3) = 1.008; mean/SD = 0.504 against a per-seed sign bar that needs a ratio near 1 to be reached reliably, and no dispersion estimate was recorded to check that against. (6) No manipulation check: nothing in the manifest establishes that ARM_ZRESOURCE's cue carried any resource-identity content at all.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: partially coupled. The manipulated flag changes agent behaviour, and the DV is computed over an anchor pool that accumulates only within an episode (agent.reset() wipes the SD-039 anchor set at every episode boundary), so episode length feeds the DV path. Within-pair, the arm with more total_steps had the higher discrimination delta in 4 of 4 informative seed pairs (42: ZR 2173 vs 1642; 45: ZW 874 vs 2957; 46: ZW 300 vs 2952; 47: ZR 2218 vs 708); across the 8 informative cells Spearman(total_steps, delta) = 0.50 and Spearman(n_qualifying_ticks, delta) = 0.48. The driver's DV-SYMMETRY declaration considers and dismisses exactly one confound -- type-clustered spatial resource placement -- and does not mention this one.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: likely insufficient. Untrained predictors throughout; 5 seeds of which 4 are informative; the decisive statistic estimated from as few as 3 ticks in one cell; and the R0 mechanism-off sanity leg observed a single E3 tick with zero no_z_goal reasons recorded (all_no_z_goal false), so the negative control did not in fact demonstrate what it was written to demonstrate.

failure_location.net_classification: MIXED -- MECHANISM not established (the convergence operator MECH-162 asserts does not exist anywhere in the substrate: update_z_goal is a strict XOR and GhostGoalBank.rank never reads z_world), MEASURES not established (readiness-failed seed inside the C1 denominator with a hardcoded 0.0 that can never enter the numerator; 59x unequal per-seed n weighted equally; the verdict inverts under the entry-weighted contrast recorded in the same manifest; no manipulation check), ENVIRONMENT partial (one starved seed and a 10x within-pair episode-length asymmetry). biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Dentate gyrus / hippocampal binding of an internally-generated spatial map with externally-derived object identity, fed by the parallel lateral (object/item) and medial (spatial) entorhinal streams originating in perirhinal and parahippocampal/postrhinal cortex.
dependencies: lateral and medial entorhinal routing, goal-conditioned per Lee 2021 GIST stage 2
dentate-gyrus sparse pattern separation as the binding locus (Kim 2015)
CA3/CA1 for downstream retrieval and goal update
biological_reference.divergence: REE's translation is incomplete rather than divergent. The separation half (SD-015's z_resource vs z_world) is a faithful translation of the PrC/PhC dissociation and is built. The convergence half -- the DG-analog operator that takes both streams and produces a bound episodic/planning representation -- has no counterpart in the substrate at all. The failure signature is exactly what the biology predicts if the binding locus were removed and only one afferent stream were allowed through to the planner at a time. Under the skill's core principle this is a discovered prerequisite, not a falsification. The one genuinely open biological question is the FORM of the operator, which Lee 2021's own review names as unspecified (concatenation / multiplicative gating / cross-attention / factor-graph product) -- that is Q-030 axis 3 and is the reason the build below is a smallest-step, not a settled design.
biological_reference.lit_status_scope: PRESENT for the convergence claim itself -- 11 entries across targeted_review_q_030 (5, three of which name MECH-162 explicitly; Kim 2015 causal lesion evidence, Staresina 2011 double dissociation, Lee 2021 GIST at confidence 0.82) and targeted_review_sd_015 (6, including Whittington 2022, the Tolman-Eichenbaum source the claim's own notes cite). ABSENT for the binding OPERATOR -- which fusion computation the planner should perform -- named as an explicit gap by the strongest single anchor. Neither review directory carries a SYNTHESIS.md, only entries/, so there is no roll-up to cite. No /lit-pull is owed on the existence of the convergence; a narrow one on the operator would serve the build below and is the same gap Q-030 axis 3 already tracks.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-09-04 (failure autopsy V3-EXQ-997, staging draft awaiting confirmation): V3-EXQ-997 self-declared FAIL / weakens. NOT SCORED as weakens -- the run tested a SUBSTITUTION, not the CONVERGENCE MECH-162 asserts, and its own decisive statistic is not robust. (1) SCOPE: MECH-162 asserts z_resource and z_world must re-converge at the hippocampal planning stage, and the claim's notes name three permutations ('z_resource alone, z_world alone, and both fused'). The run built the two 'alone' arms only. Code read confirms this is a substrate absence, not a design choice: ree_core/agent.py::update_z_goal (~11504) seeds z_goal from z_resource OR z_world via a strict XOR, and ree_core/hippocampal/ghost_goal_bank.py::GhostGoalBank.rank never reads z_world (four live terms: wanting, goal_match, staleness, recoverability). Both arms therefore instantiate the claim's negative condition; a contrast between them cannot weaken a claim about the positive one. (2) PRECONDITION: ResourceEncoder's documented phased protocol (ree_core/latent/stack.py:288-291) requires P0 supervised training before P1 goal seeding. This run activated P1 with no training of any kind, so z_resource was an untrained projection; SD-015's own record measures untrained identity content at goal_resource_r 0.066-0.087 against 0.93-0.96 trained (V3-EXQ-514o under SD-057). No manipulation check was recorded, so it is not established that ARM_ZRESOURCE's cue carried identity information at all. (3) ROBUSTNESS: C1's mean half passed (0.0636 >= 0.02) but its seed half failed (0.40 < 0.60), and the seed statistic does not survive scrutiny -- the readiness-failed seed 43 sits inside the denominator with a hardcoded 0.0 that makes 'zr > zw' structurally False, capping the attainable fraction at 0.8 and raising the effective bar to 3 of 4 informative seeds; per-seed estimates are equally weighted across qualifying-tick counts spanning 3 to 177; the sign split on the 4 informative seeds is 2/2 (two-sided p = 1.000, t(3) = 1.008, mean/SD = 0.504); dropping seed 47 alone puts the mean below the 0.02 floor (+0.0092); and recomputing C1 from the entry-weighted contrast already present in the same manifest gives mean 0.1032 and seed fraction 0.60, i.e. C1 PASSES. A verdict that inverts on an undeclared aggregation choice is not a weakens. (4) CONFOUND: the arm with more total_steps had the higher discrimination delta in 4 of 4 informative seed pairs (Spearman(steps, delta) = 0.50 over the 8 informative cells); because agent.reset() wipes the SD-039 anchor set every episode, episode length feeds the DV path, and the driver's DV-symmetry declaration does not consider it. WHAT THE RUN DOES ESTABLISH, recorded as read-across not scored here: the MECH-292/293 waking ghost-goal retrieval channel is live and carries a genuine positive same-type-over-different-type discrimination from BOTH seed latents on every informative cell (per-tick 0.021 to 0.303; ghost admission nonzero on 0.50-0.965 of E3 ticks; z_goal_stream active_frac 0.9815, no writer defect). That is evidence about MECH-236/292/293, which are not tagged on this run. STATE AFTER THIS DISPOSITION, stated plainly: MECH-162 returns to ZERO scoring experimental entries and rests on literature alone (11 entries across targeted_review_q_030 and targeted_review_sd_015, including Kim 2015's causal DG-lesion evidence and Staresina 2011's double dissociation, both of which the reviews record as supporting MECH-162). There is no illusory-conflict risk in the narrow sense -- there were no prior supports to leave standing -- but the claim is now explicitly lit-only, which is the honest reading and not a demotion. ROUTE: implement-substrate. Build a joint z_resource + z_world planning input so the three-permutation test the claim's own notes specify becomes runnable; retest MECH-162 only with a third fused arm AND a P0-trained ResourceEncoder AND a recorded per-arm manipulation check. Do not re-issue a two-arm lettered variant of V3-EXQ-997.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: the open question here is a discrimination among four structurally different explanations of one uninformative null, each on a different design axis, not a single already-named build. H3's probe is gated on the recommended_substrate_queue_entry landing; H2 needs no new run at all and should go first on cost grounds; H1 and H4 are independent and can run in parallel. Design-audit for coverage and verdict-aliasing before queuing -- in particular H1 and H4 can alias (a trained encoder may also survive longer), so the H1 probe must carry H4's step/tick matching.
fanout_recommendation.revision_note_2026_09_04: Red-team F1 accepted: H0 ('a fused planning input adds nothing over either single stream') is ALIVE, not eliminated on structure -- the retrieval-form fusion exists and was live. The first leg of the next portfolio is the explicit three-permutation MECH-162 retest (z_resource-seeded / z_world-seeded / explicit joint cue) with the retrieval form ON, the C1 denominator restricted to readiness-passing seeds, tick-count weighting or a pre-registered minimum-ticks floor, a trained ResourceEncoder (P0 before P1, manipulation check goal_resource_r recorded), and matched or covaried episode length (F2: early termination is starvation, a mediator not an exogenous confound). A same-claim re-issue is LEGITIMATE here (brake count 0; instrument category).

learning_extracted: A criterion computed over ALL seeds while its readiness gate is evaluated as a run-level seed FRACTION lets a readiness-failed seed sit permanently in the denominator. Here _run_cell's `fmean(samples) if samples else 0.0` fallback made seed 43's contribution a hardcoded 0.0, and because the seed test is a strict `zr > zw`, `0.0 > 0.0` is False -- so that seed could never enter the numerator, silently raising the effective bar from 60% to 75% of informative seeds. Aggregate over the seeds that cleared readiness, or make the readiness gate per-seed-exclusionary.

Pre-registering a DV FORMULA is not the same as pre-registering a ROBUST one. The per-tick unweighted contrast and the entry-weighted contrast are both recorded in this manifest, differ in sign on two cells, and invert the run's PASS/FAIL verdict. A driver that computes both owes a declaration of which is decisive and a reported sensitivity on the other.

Recording gap, cheap to close and decision-blocking: when the manipulation IS 'which latent seeds the cue', a per-arm manipulation check on the cue's content is owed. Nothing in this manifest establishes that ARM_ZRESOURCE's cue carried resource-identity information, and SD-015's own record puts the untrained baseline at goal_resource_r 0.066-0.087 against 0.93-0.96 trained. Per the Experimental Recording Standard, the repair is recording the readout in the re-run, not re-running blind.

Activating a module's phase P1 while skipping the P0 its own source documents (ree_core/latent/stack.py:288-291) is a precondition violation, not a scoping choice, whenever the DV is about the CONTENT the module encodes rather than the existence of its wiring. The 'untrained predictors are the correct substrate state' argument, sound for an architectural-coupling probe, does not transfer to a representational-content probe.

A claim asserting CONVERGENCE of two streams is not tested by a SUBSTITUTION contrast between them. MECH-162's own notes enumerate three permutations ('z_resource alone, z_world alone, and both fused'); the run built two and omitted the one that carries the claim. Reading the claim's notes for its own named design space is the cheapest available guard against this class of scope error.

When the manipulated flag changes behaviour and the DV accumulates within an episode, episode length becomes a nuisance variable ON the DV path. Here the longer-running arm won 4 of 4 informative seed pairs. The DV-symmetry declaration should enumerate behaviour-mediated confounds, not only stimulus-side ones -- this driver considered and dismissed spatial type-clustering and did not consider survival.

A negative-control leg that observes a single tick has not run. The R0 mechanism-off sanity leg recorded n_e3_ticks_observed 1, n_no_z_goal_reason 0, all_no_z_goal false -- it is vacuous as executed, and nothing gated on it, so its vacuity was invisible in the verdict.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry_origin.title: Joint z_resource + z_world input at the hippocampal planning stage (fused goal/retrieval cue), so the three-permutation MECH-162 / Q-030 test becomes runnable
recommended_substrate_queue_entry_origin.implementation_hint: Today the planning-stage goal cue is single-stream by construction in two independent places, and no config flag reaches a both-streams condition.
